_comment: Public-facing tier - the only tier in this example set that legitimately opens anything to 0.0.0.0/0. SSH is scoped to a placeholder admin CIDR, not the world - replace ADMIN_CIDR before applying.

ingress.description: HTTP from internet (redirects to HTTPS at the app, not here)
SSH from office/admin CIDR only - replace with your actual range, never 0.0.0.0/0

egress.description: default all-outbound - fine for a web tier that needs to reach package registries, the app tier, and AWS APIs
